svg.title: Strategy plugins: a row mounts one, a gate decides what it may do
svg.desc: Strategies, the bars they read, the cost model and the evaluator are separate plugins mounted by configuration rows on one kernel. The live rows provide the factor service the brief, report and intraday paths compute with. The research rows search a declared parameter grid walking forward and produce a proposal that is a candidate or refused, never live permission. Alternate gates are recorded beside the verdict and do not bind.

text.tspan: Add, swap or retune a strategy by editing a row.
A plugin can compute. Only a registered gate lets a proposal through.
One kernel, one row per plugin
A plugin provides a service or declares the ones it needs; mount order does not matter.
Everything it registers is undone when it is unmounted. New settings restart it.
The module behind a row may live outside this package.
Brief, report and intraday read it.
Identical output to the code it replaced.
A strategy with its declared grid
Refits only on returns already realised.
Edge and lift intervals above zero
Candidate or refused. Never live permission.
Other thresholds judge the same run:
Each records would-pass and why not.
A second opinion kept beside the verdict.
Every run leaves its verdict, each alternate's verdict and the digest of the bars it read.
Yield is counted over distinct inputs. Registering new parameters is an edit to a row.
Research output is evidence for review: it places no order and changes no live parameter.
